<subject>RE: energy policy forum</subject>
<body>
Hi Joannie —

Carrie is a Queensland commissioner and we have invited two other Queensland commissioners. Assuming one of her colleagues, Judith Harper or David McIntyre, accepts, there is no need to send an alternate. We appreciate the offer though.

Thanks, MRA

-----Original Message-----
From: Williamson, Joannie  
Sent: Monday, July 23, 2001 11:47 AM
To: Allen, Margaret
Subject: FW: energy policy forum

FYI...

-----Original Message-----
From: "Swanson-Hull, Camie" <CSwanson-Hull@qld.gov.au> 
Sent: Monday, July 23, 2001 10:47 AM
To: Skilling, Jeff
Subject: energy policy forum

Mr. Skilling,  
Thank you for your kind invitation to participate in the interesting program that you are sponsoring in October. Unfortunately, I have a conflicting commitment and will be unable to attend. May I pass the information on to one of the other Commissioners here, or have you also invited others from our commission?  
Thank you.  
Camie Swanson-Hull
</body>
